integrity.unproved_limits: No claim is made for different Pareto parameterizations or other distribution families.

scientific_limitations: The exact existence and uniqueness of the Pareto optimizer for kappa>1 are already established implicitly in arXiv:2305.02114; the new claim is the branch-resolved closed form and endpoint scaling.
The result is specific to the Pareto type-I mean-threshold functional.
An equivalent elementary transformation could exist under poorly indexed Pareto or Lambert-W terminology.
title: Critical square-root law for the Pareto mean-threshold infimum
